title: heliconia undulata
intro: Heliconia undulata, commonly known as the wavy heliconia or wavy lobster claw, is a species of flowering plant in the family Heliconiaceae. This plant is known for its vibrant flowers, which have wavy, claw-like petals that attract hummingbirds and other pollinators. The health benefits of Heliconia undulata include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
